description: Takes a loan amount, annual rate and tenure, plus optional prepayments or a rate change, and returns the monthly EMI, total interest and year-by-year schedule for an Indian home loan. Example input: {"principal":5000000,"annualRate":8.5,"years":20}

annualRate.description: Annual interest rate in percent, for example 8.5

lumpSums.description: One-time prepayments as a list of { month, amount }, or a string like "12:100000,24:50000"

mode.description: What prepayment shortens: reduceTenure (default) or reduceEMI

monthly.description: Set true to include the month-by-month schedule in the result

months.description: Loan tenure in months (6 to 480). Give months or years.

rateReset.description: A floating-rate change part-way through the loan

afterMonth.description: Month after which the new rate applies

years.description: Loan tenure in years (0.5 to 40). Give months or years.

name: emi
